story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: How It All Began
paragraphs: Our story began at Qorikancha, an ancient Incan temple in Cusco, Peru. We noticed each other right away, the only two Asian faces in the crowd, but didn't say a word.
Weeks later, we both happened to check into Hotel Prada, a guesthouse in Lima. This time we introduced ourselves and spent days sharing meals, drinking coffee, and exploring the city.

We weren't ready to say goodbye, so we kept travelling together. We stood on the equator in Quito, Ecuador, learnt Spanish and danced salsa in Colombia, then visited New York City and Niagara Falls. A few months later, we reunited in Nagoya, Japan.
Then came Hong Kong, where Man Man grew up and Ken got to see her world. After all those travels, Ken knew without a doubt that Man Man was the perfect partner for life.
Now we're ready for our greatest adventure yet, and we want you there when we say "I do."
